stats.notes: World Cup defending champions (2022). Elite squad depth with world-class talent across all positions. Mbappe leads devastating attack. Strong defensive structure anchored by world-class midfield.

African champions. Physically imposing team with pace on the counter. Sadio Mane provides attacking threat. Strong defensive organization but missing key creator in midfield. Underdogs but dangerous on transition.

sharp_consensus.prop_angle: France Star Forward - Anytime Goalscorer (Senegal missing creator, France dominance expected)
sharp_consensus.league_notes: World Cup 2026 - 48-team expanded format. France defending champions (2022). Senegal African champions.
sharp_consensus.keyMatchup: France's elite attack (#2 FIFA ranked) vs Senegal's organized defense (#18). Class difference in midfield.
sharp_consensus.rankGap: France #2 FIFA, Senegal #18. France has significantly higher xG creation (2.10 vs 1.55).
sharp_consensus.senegalWeakness: Senegal missing key creator in midfield. They'll rely on counter-attacks and set pieces. France defense is stingy (0.95 xGA).
sharp_consensus.sharpReasoning: Sharp money on France. World Cup holders have too much quality. Senegal can be dangerous on the break but expect France to control possession and create higher-quality chances.
